spans.s:
m. (-द्घः)
Excellence, happiness.
E.
उद much, घण to shine, affix ड or उद before हन to strike, अप् aff. and the final rejected.

m. (-नः)
A carpenter's work-bench, a plank on which he works.
E.
उद् above, हन to injure, अप् affix, ह changed to घ.

n. (-नं)
Opening, opening up as a lid.
E.
उद् up, and घट्टन fastening.

n. (-नं)
1 The rope and bucket of a well, a leather bucket used for drawing water.
2 Opening, unlocking.
3 An opener, the instrument or means of opening, a key, &c.
4 Hosting, raising, lifting up.
E.
उद up, घट^1 to strive, affix ल्युट्; also with वुञ् affix उद्घाटक.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161211. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 307,308.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Opened, unlocked.
E.
उद up, and घट्टित fastened.

Raised, hoisted or lifted up.
E.
उद much, घट to exert, affix क्त.

n. (-णं)
1 Rubbing, rubbing up.
2 Rubbing the skin with hard substances, as vitrified brick, &c.
E.
उद् and घर्षण friction.

n. (-सं)
Flesh.
E.
उद, घस substituted, for अद to eat, affix अप्; what is eaten.

m. (-टः)
A watch or guard house.
E.
उद up, घट to endeavour, &c. घञ् aff.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 A key.
2 A bucket, &c. see the next.
3 An opener, the instrument or agent of opening any thing.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Wise, intelligent.
E.
उद् much, घट to endeavour, affix क्त, and ज्ञ who knows.

Naked.
E.
उद्घाटित and अङ्ग the body.

m. (-तः)
1 A beginning, a thing begun.
2 A weapon.
3 A club, a mallet.
4 Striking, wounding, inflicting a hurt.
5 A wound, a blow.
6 The division of a book, a chapter, a section.
7 Breathing through the nostrils as a religious exercise.
8 Slipping, tripping.
9 High, tall.
E.
उद before हन to kill or destroy, and घञ् affix, त is substituted for न.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Sounded out.
E.
उद before घुष् to sound, affix क्त.
